summary.shortDescription: A 4000mAh silicon-anode 18650 energy and mid-power cell with a 12A continuous rating.
summary.description: Amprius's SA110 is a distinct 18650 cell with 4000mAh typical capacity, 12A maximum continuous discharge, and 20A pulse capability. Battery Mooch published an exact-model vaping test, making the product relevant to a catalog that currently lacks a 4000mAh 18650 identity.

sources.title: Amprius product catalog and SA110 technical data
Bench Test Results: Amprius INR18650/40 (SA110) - 12A 4000mAh 18650
sources.limitations: Full exact-model report text was retrieved through the ECF feed and reviewed; the feed is a presentation of the original forum report.

claims.statement: Amprius identifies SA110 as its exact 4Ah energy and mid-power 18650 product.
The SA110 data sheet gives 4000mAh typical and 3850mAh minimum capacity.
Amprius specifies 12A maximum continuous and 20A pulse discharge.
The retrieved exact-model vaping report measured 4165–4181mAh, found 12A reasonable, and preferred operation at 9A or below.

safetyFindings.summary: The manufacturer separates the 12A maximum continuous rating from the 20A pulse value.
safetyFindings.runtimeImplication: Use 12A as the proposed calculator limit.
